name: @onestop-trade/onestop-mcp

tools.name: wallet
tools.description: This MCP's wallet address and its link to onestop: whether it's logged in to the engine, the API it uses, whether dry run is on, and how many orders and plans it's tracking. No network call. Call it first: every other tool acts for this wallet.

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Wait up to 20 seconds for the engine login, then report the same as wallet. The MCP logs in by itself at start and again after any drop, backing off up to 30 seconds between tries, so use this to wait for it rather than retrying another tool.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Price a swap without trading. Returns amount_in, expected_out, min_out, the fee (1%) and the gas (both taken from the trade), and transaction.base64: the unsigned transaction, good for about 45 seconds. Nothing is signed or sent. Pass the transaction to submit_swap to trade it after looking at the quote, or use swap to do both at once.

input.description: what to spend: a mint, or SOL, USDC, USDT

output.description: what to get: a mint, or SOL, USDC, USDT

amount.description: raw units of the input (lamports for SOL). Give this or holdings_bps

holdings_bps.description: or a share of the wallet's balance of the input, 10000 = all

slippage_bps.description: the most the price may move against a fill, default 300 = 3%

tools.name: submit_swap
tools.description: Trade a transaction from quote. The MCP checks it with the guard first, simulating it on the wallet's own RPC: onestop pays the fee, only this wallet signs besides it, nothing approves or reassigns the wallet's accounts, the wallet loses no more than the quote says, and the output arrives. Then it signs, sends it through onestop's MEV-protected lane and waits for it to land. Only a transaction this MCP quoted recently is accepted, because the guard needs its quote and onestop co-signs only trades it quoted. Returns confirmed with the signature and the wallet's balance changes, or refused with the guard's reasons. With dry run it stops after the guard.

tools.name: swap
tools.description: Swap now in one call: quote, guard, sign and send, the same as quote followed by submit_swap. No SOL needed for gas: onestop pays it and takes it, with the 1% fee, from the trade. Returns the amounts and the result: confirmed with the signature and balance changes, refused with the guard's reasons, or dry_run.

input.description: what to spend: a mint, or SOL, USDC, USDT

output.description: what to get: a mint, or SOL, USDC, USDT

amount.description: raw units of the input (lamports for SOL). Give this or holdings_bps

holdings_bps.description: or a share of the wallet's balance of the input, 10000 = all

slippage_bps.description: the most the price may move against a fill, default 300 = 3%

tools.name: tokens
tools.description: Price, market cap, liquidity and main pool for up to 100 tokens. Read only.

tools.name: holdings
tools.description: A wallet's SOL and token balances, valued in USD. Read only.

wallet.description: the wallet to look at, default this MCP's

tools.name: limit_order
tools.description: A limit order: buy or sell when the market cap crosses a level, given as target_bps of the market cap now (above it, a take profit or a breakout buy; below it, a stop loss or a dip buy) or as target_mcap_usd. It fires only on a cross after placement. Add twap_slices and twap_interval_s to fill in slices. A buy takes amount in lamports; a sell takes amount in raw token units or holdings_bps of the balance when it fires. paper: true rehearses with real prices and never trades. It lapses after expires_h hours if it hasn't fired. Returns the order with its order_id; follow it with get_order. Signing: fills are signed by this MCP process. If it isn't running when an order fires, the fill is queued and executed on reconnect at the then-current price.

side.description: buy spends SOL on the token; sell sells the token for SOL

amount.description: a buy: the SOL to spend, in lamports (1 SOL = 1000000000). A sell: raw token units. Give this or holdings_bps

holdings_bps.description: a sell: the share of the wallet's balance when it fires, 10000 = all

target_bps.description: the level as a share of the market cap now: 20000 = 2x, 5000 = half

target_mcap_usd.description: or the level as a market cap in USD

twap_slices.description: fill in this many slices instead of one swap

slippage_bps.description: the most the price may move against a fill, default 300 = 3%

expires_h.description: hours until it lapses if it hasn't fired, default 24

paper.description: true: rehearse with real prices; fills are recorded, never signed or traded

tools.name: trailing_order
tools.description: A trailing order: a sell follows the market cap up and fires when it falls trail_bps from its high; a buy follows it down and fires when it rises trail_bps from its low. Add twap_slices and twap_interval_s to fill in slices. A buy takes amount in lamports; a sell takes amount in raw token units or holdings_bps of the balance when it fires. paper: true rehearses with real prices and never trades. It lapses after expires_h hours if it hasn't fired. Returns the order with its order_id; follow it with get_order. Signing: fills are signed by this MCP process. If it isn't running when an order fires, the fill is queued and executed on reconnect at the then-current price.

holdings_bps.description: a sell: the share of the wallet's balance when it fires, 10000 = all

trail_bps.description: how far the market cap must move back from its best to fire: 1000 = 10%

twap_slices.description: fill in this many slices instead of one swap

tools.name: limit_trailing_order
tools.description: A limit, then a trail: it waits for the market cap to reach the level (target_bps of the market cap now, or target_mcap_usd), then trails from there and fires when the market cap moves back trail_bps from its best. A sell above the market cap now lets a winner run past the target and keeps the gain. Add twap_slices and twap_interval_s to fill in slices. A buy takes amount in lamports; a sell takes amount in raw token units or holdings_bps of the balance when it fires. paper: true rehearses with real prices and never trades. It lapses after expires_h hours if it hasn't fired. Returns the order with its order_id; follow it with get_order. Signing: fills are signed by this MCP process. If it isn't running when an order fires, the fill is queued and executed on reconnect at the then-current price.

tools.name: twap_order
tools.description: A TWAP order: buy or sell now in twap_slices swaps twap_interval_s seconds apart, to spread the price impact. Each slice is what's left divided by the slices left. A buy takes amount in lamports; a sell takes amount in raw token units or holdings_bps of the balance when it fires. paper: true rehearses with real prices and never trades. It lapses after expires_h hours if it hasn't fired. Returns the order with its order_id; follow it with get_order. Signing: fills are signed by this MCP process. If it isn't running when an order fires, the fill is queued and executed on reconnect at the then-current price.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: This wallet's orders, newest first. An order is waiting, armed (trailing from its best), filling, then filled, cancelled, expired or failed.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: One order: its status, trigger levels, the market cap it saw last, its slices and its fills with their signatures.

order_id.description: the order_id the order was placed with

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an order. A slice that's already signed can't be called back; the rest of the order stops. A plan's orders are cancelled with cancel_plan.

order_id.description: the order_id the order was placed with

tools.name: extend_order
tools.description: Set an open order's expiry to expires_h hours from now.

order_id.description: the order_id the order was placed with

expires_h.description: hours from now until it lapses

tools.name: place_plan
tools.description: A plan: an entry buy, then an exit onestop creates for exactly the tokens the entry bought. protect arms once the market cap reaches arm_bps of the entry's (30000 = 3x) and then sells when it falls trail_bps from its high. exit takes profit at target_bps of the entry market cap, or shapes the protected sell (twap, and sell_bps of the tokens); with neither level the exit sells at once. A plan needs protect or exit. To protect tokens already held, leave out entry and give amount or holdings_bps. Returns the plan with its plan_id; follow it with get_plan. Signing: fills are signed by this MCP process. If it isn't running when an order fires, the fill is queued and executed on reconnect at the then-current price.

entry.description: the buy; leave it out to protect tokens already held

amount.description: the SOL to spend, in lamports

target_bps.description: the level as a share of the market cap now: 20000 = 2x, 5000 = half

target_mcap_usd.description: or the level as a market cap in USD

trail_bps.description: how far the market cap must move back from its best to fire: 1000 = 10%

trigger.description: when to buy, as in the order tools

slices.description: fill in this many slices instead of one swap

protect.description: a trailing stop that arms at arm_bps of the entry market cap

arm_bps.description: arms at this share of the entry market cap: 30000 = 3x

trail_bps.description: how far the market cap must move back from its best to fire: 1000 = 10%

exit.description: a take profit at target_bps of the entry market cap, and how the exit sells: twap, sell_bps of the tokens (default all)

target_bps.description: the level as a share of the market cap now: 20000 = 2x, 5000 = half

slices.description: fill in this many slices instead of one swap

sell_bps.description: the share of the tokens to sell, default 10000 = all

amount.description: without an entry: raw units of the token already held

holdings_bps.description: without an entry: or a share of the wallet's balance of it

slippage_bps.description: the most the price may move against a fill, default 300 = 3%

expires_h.description: hours until it lapses if it hasn't fired, default 24

paper.description: true: rehearse with real prices; fills are recorded, never signed or traded

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: A plan's progress: the entry's fills, the tokens it bought and its average entry market cap, the exit (armed with its high and stop, or its take-profit level), and the market cap now as a multiple of the entry.

plan_id.description: the plan_id the plan was placed with

tools.name: cancel_plan
tools.description: Cancel a plan and every stage that hasn't run. Tokens already bought stay in the wallet.

plan_id.description: the plan_id the plan was placed with

tools.name: activity
tools.description: What this MCP did since it started, newest first: fills it signed (with signatures) or refused (with the reason), paper fills, exits it took on, and order and plan updates.

instructions: Trade Solana tokens through onestop: gasless swaps (no SOL needed; a 1% fee plus the network cost, both taken from the trade), market-cap orders and plans that buy and then protect a position. Amounts are raw units (lamports for SOL); levels are basis points. Call wallet first. Signing: fills are signed by this MCP process. If it isn't running when an order fires, the fill is queued and executed on reconnect at the then-current price.
